claims.statement: For the fixed nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 supplied by the challenge and uniform z in the order-r subgroup of GT (identity included), the disclosed classical algorithm returns Q in G2 with the pinned reduced pairing e(P,Q)=z with success floor 0.39, and its complete classical work is at most 2^126.2672 dense-Fp12-multiplication equivalents at the protected C=20000, summed over all processors with no amortisation. THREE JUDGE-NAMED DEFECTS OF v26 ARE FIXED AND RE-MEASURED. (1) DP PREDICATE AT CENSUS TIME: v26 stored and checked every visited class key and never applied the 2^-80 distinguished-point filter; v27 executes routing.dp_hit at census time, stores reports only, restarts the trail at each report, and counts success as DP-hit AND agree. Count row over n=180000 trials at four report depths: 1,417,698 keys stored by the old protocol at dp=1 versus 735,725 DP hits, 35,207 report collisions and 35,207 verified recoveries, p_agree_given_collision=1.000000. The production-like arm (S/theta=16, the largest the 785-element fixture admits) reads 0.5868 with CP-95 lower 0.5835; the deeper-report arms read 0.3894, 0.2483, 0.1501 and are DISCLOSED as budget-limited fixture regimes, not production rates, since production runs at S/theta=2^45.83. The model is now the disclosed one, 1-exp(-S^2(1-f^2)/(2 mu N)), which at S=32,N=785,f=3/8,mu=1.1 gives 0.399237 -- reproducing the judge's own 0.399 to 2.4e-4; v26's code computed 0.479117, a different formula. The DP-restart non-equivalence is CHARGED, not asserted away: a merge is credited only if the follower reaches the common downstream report, P(miss|merge) <= E[Exp(theta)]/(128 theta) = 1/128, and S is sized so (1-1/128)(1-exp(-S^2(1-f^2)/(2 mu N))) >= 0.39 at production, costing +0.0075 bits. (2) TRAP POPULATION: v26 charged four abandon probabilities against an S/theta restart schedule; the true population is n_trails = ceil(S/theta) = 62,484,585,866,263 trail starts (understated by 2^43.83), each charged row-by-row with P=E[L^2]/(2N), L=min(Exp(theta),128 theta), wasted work <= E[L] = theta, giving 2^35.3257 instead of 2^11.497, still 2^90.9 below the step term. The Chernoff 'overflow bound' is DELETED and replaced by literal cap semantics: a trail restarts at its first report so it stores at most one report and the report count is deterministically <= ceil(S/theta). (3) ALGEBRA: sigma^j(y)=y^(p^j), so the two-step return is y^(4-p^j)=(m1^4 m2^2)^(-1), not y^3=sigma^j/(m1^4 m2^2); recovery inverts e_j=(4-p^j) mod r on the subgroup order r with gcd(e_j,r)=1. Dynamic proof on the shipped object: 200 table rows x 50 solves for each j in {0,1,2,3}, 40000 exact solves, 0 misses, 0 subgroup failures, and the j=0 arm reproduces the old cubing exactly (regression kept) while the old cubing returns 0 of 30000 for j!=0. full_map_census now keys states by the full twelve-value class signature: 9420 distinct exact states (v26 collapsed them onto 785 by dlog[class_key], factor 12.00 disclosed) and the squared step has 0 two-cycles on the exact map. LEDGER, ONE SUM, EVERY ROW DISPLAYED, Fractions throughout: S*c_stress (2^126.267148) + trap charge (2^35.325690) + 8 enumerated aux rows at the report cap (2^56.517206) = 2^126.267148; claim 126.2672 = 78917/625, the least 4-decimal log2 >= the exact total, reduced. f=0.346631 is the EXECUTED squaring fraction over the v27 census (declared 3/8), priced at the more expensive reading. FAMILY-FREE BY THEOREM, NOT BY DEBIT: class merging forces m(k)=sigma^(-k)(A_t) and sigma^6 is inversion on the order-r subgroup, so the inverse-pair family is an identity of the orbit structure (384/384 columns measured, planted mutation flags exactly the mutated column); squaring is the minimal sound fix. RANK LOSS DISCLOSED, NEVER HIDDEN: 126.2672 is 0.4472 bits behind the live board minimum 125.82 and 0.4292 behind this account's valid 125.838.

title: Squared-step class-merge rho for fixed-G1 pairing inversion: DP-predicate census, corrected trap population, and per-class return algebra
